description: This file contains an implementation of the DittoProtocolSub interface, specifically the class DittoProtocolSubImpl, which manages subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and acknowledgement labels for a pub/sub system within a larger Eclipse Ditto project. It interacts with various pub/sub components, Factories, and actors to manage distributed subscriptions related to device or thing events.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSubImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the DittoProtocolSub interface, managing pub/sub subscriptions and acknowledgements within the Ditto system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method for creating a new DittoProtocolSubImpl instance, initializing distributed subscriptions with the given actor context.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a given actor reference to specified streaming types and topics, applying filtering as needed.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from both live signal and twin event subscriptions.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates live signal subscriptions based on streaming types and topics for a subscriber.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Unsubscribes a twin event subscriber from specified topics.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels with the twin event subscription, ensuring they are fully resolved beforehand.

methods.name: ensureAcknowledgementLabelsAreFullyResolved
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgement labels are fully resolved; throws if any are not.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: partitionByStreamingTypes
methods.description: Partitions a collection of streaming types into live signals and twin events, performing corresponding actions.

methods.name: toFilter
methods.description: Creates a predicate filter to match topics based on streaming types.
